description: Image Pakistan Limited was established in 1993 as a fabric manufacturing company and describes itself as one of Pakistan's leading fashion and retail houses. Its principal activity is the manufacturing and sale of embroidered fabric and ready-to-wear garments under the brand name Image, with Schiffli embroidered fabric long associated with the company. It sells unstitched and ready-to-wear collections through stores in five cities in Pakistan and online, and states it was the first Pakistani seller to list on Amazon.
